name: Epithelioid Sarcoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Histopathological and Immunohistochemical Diagnostic Criteria for Epithelioid Sarcoma

criteria.description: Presence of nodular aggregates of epithelioid and spindle cells with central necrosis
Loss of INI1 (SMARCB1) expression in tumor cells
Slow-growing painless subcutaneous or deep soft tissue mass, often in distal extremities

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation with characteristic morphology plus loss of INI1 expression on immunohistochemistry
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Molecular testing for SMARCB1 gene alterations may support diagnosis

pathognomonic.symptomName: Painless firm subcutaneous nodule or mass
Central tumor necrosis with nodular growth pattern
searchTerms: tumor with central dead tissue and nodular growth

common.symptomName: Slow progressive enlargement of soft tissue mass
searchTerms: gradual growth of soft tissue lump

common.symptomName: Ulceration of overlying skin in advanced lesions
searchTerms: open sores on large skin tumors

occasional.symptomName: Pain or tenderness at tumor site
Restricted joint movement adjacent to tumor
searchTerms: restricted motion in joint adjacent to mass
tumor spread to brain causing neurological signs

laboratory: Histopathology showing epithelioid and spindle cells with central necrosis
Immunohistochemistry demonstrating loss of INI1 (SMARCB1) expression
imaging: MRI showing soft tissue mass with heterogeneous signal intensity
CT scan for detection of lung metastases
other: Lymph node biopsy may reveal metastatic epithelioid sarcoma cells

distinguishingFeatures: Different immunohistochemical profile with retained INI1 expression
Typically occurs in infants and young children
Similar INI1 loss but different histological features

redFlags: Rapid increase in size of soft tissue mass
Regional lymphadenopathy or evidence of metastasis
references: Fletcher CDM, Bridge JA, Hogendoorn PCW, Mertens F. WHO Classification of Tumours of Soft Tissue and Bone. IARC; 2020.
Hornick JL. Epithelioid sarcoma: diagnostic features and differential diagnosis. Arch Pathol Lab Med. 2011.
